divergence_log: Classical Fisher-Neyman sufficiency uses factorization p(x|theta)=g(T(x),theta)h(x); information-preserving coarse-graining is defined on a commuting sample space and respects joint distributions p(theta,x). This classical substrate cannot witness Petz-recovery failure on genuinely nonclassical subalgebras.
